notes: JPN is the sole semantic and structural authority; auxiliary CN/ENG are reference only.
Coverage is contiguous for logical unique_index 0-68.
Source markers such as (不要), #, 【！】, *log_type_34, significant trailing newline and unique_index 10 trailing ASCII space are preserved.
Runtime parameters $1/$2 and icon controls <I=DEC>/<I=CAN> are preserved in original order.
Fixed feature identities RECRUIT, TRADE, DELIVERY, OUTER OPS and METAL GEAR ZEKE remain JPN-authoritative.
Auxiliary generalizations were rejected where JPN is more specific, including 砲撃支援 and 大型兵器 wording.
